arguments.command:
set -e
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py settings open > /tmp/settings_open.json
# give UI time
sleep 1.5
./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tap void-settings-status-shuffle > /tmp/toggle_shuffle.json
cat /tmp/settings_open.json
cat /tmp/toggle_shuffle.json
# read playback state
./.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect > /tmp/inspect_after_shuffle.json
cat /tmp/inspect_after_shuffle.json
